description: Find newly-registered domains and subdomains containing one or more search terms, with registration dates. Wildcards (`*`) supported; multiple terms combine with AND. Use this when sweeping for typosquats or brand-impersonation domains being registered fresh against your brand. Do NOT use this to enumerate the existing subdomain tree of a known domain (use `subdomain_lookup`) or for typosquat verification on an already-known domain (use `typosquatting`).

domain_search_terms.description: Comma-separated domain search terms (combined with AND logic). Max 4 items. Case insensitive. Must use wildcards for partial matches otherwise the search will be exact.

domain_search_terms_exclude.description: Comma-separated domain search terms to exclude. Max 4 items. Case insensitive.

since.description: Search domains/subdomains discovered since this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

subdomains_search_terms.description: Comma-separated subdomain search terms (combined with AND logic). Max 4 items. Case insensitive.

subdomains_search_terms_exclude.description: Comma-separated subdomain search terms to exclude. Max 4 items. Case insensitive.

name: domain_and_subdomain_discovery
